 Order

(02.03.2026) The petitioners, through the medium of this petition, seek a direction upon the respondents not to construct the road from the land of the petitioners bearing Khasra No. 123,
measuring 02 kanal 07 marlas and Khasra No. 125 measuring 10 kanals 11 marlas and Khasra No.
125 min measuring 10 marlas situated at village Kothra Tehsil Darhal, District Rajouri without acquiring the land and paying the compensation and without following due process of law as envisaged under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Heard.

sentences.text:
Ms. Nazia Fazal, Assisting Counsel appearing vice Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG accepts notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 1 &
3.
Mr. Nirmal Kotwal, Assisting Counsel appearing vice Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG accepts notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 2 & 4 to 7.
Notice shall be issued to respondent No. 8, returnable within four weeks, subject to filing of requisites within one week.

Meanwhile, the respondents are directed not to dispossess the petitioners from their proprietary land without following due process of law and also not to construct the road from the graveyard Mohd.
